headline: Customer Solutions and Implementation | Health-Tech Delivery | AI Evaluation
summary: Four years in client-facing implementation at Greenway Health, a US EHR company. I ran discovery with close to 200 client practices, configured solutions to their workflows, trained 200+ users and turned recurring client pain points into PRDs that product teams built. I also build and evaluate AI products: I founded Roovero, an AI content SaaS now serving paying pilot clients, and I grade frontier models for accuracy at Outlier.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end EHR implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, setup and adoption.
Ran discovery with each practice to document pain points, business processes and goals, then designed and configured practice-specific workflows and widgets.
Trained 200+ end users, including providers, nurse practitioners, nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Triaged defects and patient safety issues from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring client pain points and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined provider personas, mapped end-to-end clinical workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: discovery, solution design, configuration, onboarding, training, client communication
AI product build, RAG support workflows, model evaluation and rubrics
thesis_html: The best customer solution starts with understanding the workflow before touching the tool.
why_fit: Built and shipped an AI product; evaluate model output.
